metadata.description: Agent skills by dDan4a: Omarchy plugins, parallel agent sessions on git worktrees and more.

plugins.name: omarchy-plugin
plugins.description: Write, debug and publish Omarchy shell plugins: manifest, services, bar widgets and panels across monitors, the UI kit, IPC, and the marketplace review.

plugins.name: parallel-worktrees
plugins.description: Run parallel coding-agent sessions safely: one task = one branch = one git worktree, created with a bundled script, handed off to a new session, removed once merged (merge or squash).

plugins.name: herdr-tabs
plugins.description: Split parallel ideas into Herdr tabs in the current workspace, one agent per idea, with emoji + topic tab names and a short report back to the session that opened them.
